# Optional 2K photographic detail

Poly Haven, CC0: https://polyhaven.com/license
Leafy Grass by Charlotte Baglioni: https://polyhaven.com/a/leafy_grass
Rock01: https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_01

Original 2048x2048 diffuse and OpenGL normal photographs, recompressed as JPEG (diffuse86, normal90, no chroma subsampling) without enlargement or recoloring. Files are fetched from this Site only when high quality is selected, after the playable first frame. Default first-load bundle is independent of these optional files.

Source URL template:
